title: Linking words
about: although, unless, however, eventually: the words that join ideas

entries.ex: Although it was late, the shop was still open.
The flat is small. However, it’s very cheap.
In spite of the rain, the match went ahead.
Don’t call unless it’s urgent.
Take a jacket in case it gets cold.
You can stay as long as you keep quiet.
Hurry up, otherwise we’ll miss the bus.
The road was closed; therefore, we took a detour.
He missed the train and, as a result, was late for work.
The flight was cancelled because of the fog.
I left early so that I wouldn’t miss the start.
She saved money in order to buy a car.
I read while I was waiting.

entries.ru: тогда как, в то время как
entries.ex: I like tea, whereas my wife prefers coffee.
The plan is expensive. Moreover, it won’t work.
I don’t want to go. Besides, it’s too late.
In addition to English, she speaks Arabic.
The job pays well. On the other hand, the hours are long.
I thought he was Spanish. In fact, he’s from Chile.
Actually, I don’t really like jazz.

entries.ru: в любом случае; так или иначе
entries.ex: It was raining, but we went out anyway.
After three hours, we eventually found the hotel.
In the end, we decided to stay at home.
At last! I’ve been waiting for ages.
I’ll cook. Meanwhile, you can set the table.
Call me as soon as you land.
By the time we arrived, the film had started.
Wait here until I come back.

entries.ru: с тех пор как; так как
entries.ex: I’ve known her since we were kids.
He looked as if he hadn’t slept for days.
I’ll go even if it rains.
I don’t know whether he’ll come.
There was no tea, so I had coffee instead.
Let’s walk instead of taking the bus.
Apart from Tom, everyone came.
Some birds, for instance penguins, can’t fly.
He’s economical with the truth — in other words, he lies.
To sum up, the project was a success.
As far as I know, the shop closes at nine.
